description: Customize the Sales Order grid in the Magento Admin panel to create a specialized 'Logistics View'. You must: 1. Navigate to Sales > Orders. 2. Modify the columns to SHOW 'Payment Method' and 'Shipping Information', and HIDE 'Grand Total (Base)'. 3. Save this configuration as a new View named 'Logistics View'. The view must be saved so it can be accessed later.
